text: Wide establishing shot of a diner at night, slow push in on a man in a booth as he looks up at camera.
Low angle hero shot, a woman walks toward us in slow motion, 35mm.
Handheld, over the shoulder of a man on a phone on a busy street.
Tracking shot left to right alongside a jogger on a beach at golden hour.
Static locked-off wide, two people argue in a kitchen.
Crane up from a kid on a bike to reveal the whole neighborhood.
Dolly zoom on a man standing on a rooftop at dusk.
Top down shot of a crowd crossing a street, one person in red stands still.
Whip pan from the door to a woman sitting at a desk.
Orbit 360 around a dancer in an empty warehouse.
Close up on a woman's face in the rain, rack focus.
Drone shot flying over a car on a desert highway.
Car chase at night, camera low and fast behind a sports car weaving through traffic.
A boxer shadowboxes in a dim gym, handheld push in, he stops and looks up.
Medium shot, a couple slow dances in a living room, camera slowly circles them.
POV of a skateboarder bombing a hill.
Dutch angle, a man runs down an alley away from camera.
Pull back from a close up of a woman to reveal she is alone in a huge field.
Two-shot, a man and a woman sit across from each other at a cafe table.
A runner jumps over a hurdle, camera on the ground tilts up as she passes.
Truck right past a row of trees revealing a hiker on a ridge.
Slow pan right across a city skyline at night, ends on a woman on a balcony.
Insert shot, hands typing on a laptop.
Steadicam follows a waiter through a busy restaurant kitchen.
Extreme wide, a lone figure walks out of the fog toward camera.
A dog runs toward camera across a park, camera low.
Push in on a man sitting at a bus stop while the bus pulls away behind him.
Snorricam on a woman walking through a crowd.
A surfer carries his board into the waves at sunrise, camera booms up.
A crowd of twenty people walks toward camera on a city street as the camera rises.
